messages.content:
The failure occurred in the test `testHeaderMissingWithNull` of the `CSVParserTest` class from Apache Commons CSV library. The test is parsing CSV data with a format that includes setting a null string to `""`, having an empty header value, and ignoring empty headers. When these conditions are met, a `NullPointerException` is thrown.

By looking at the code snippets, the method `withNullString(String nullString)` of the `CSVFormat` class sets the null string in the format, and the method `withHeader(String... header)` sets the header in the format.

The issue seems to be related to how the empty header value is handled when combined with the null string `""`. The implementation may not handle this specific combination correctly, leading to a `NullPointerException`.

To fix this issue, the handling of the combination of a null string `""` and an empty header value should be improved in the `CSVFormat` class.

Next, I will provide the locations that should be fixed in the codebase:
- `org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat.withNullString(java.lang.String)`
- `org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat.withHeader(java.lang.String...)`

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
